title: RoboPhys-3D: A Comprehensive Embodied World Model Evaluation via 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2608.28718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video world models increasingly serve as data engines, action planners, and simulators for embodied AI, but conventional embodied world model (EWM) benchmarks lack a unified 3D-grounded protocol for establishing whether generated rollouts preserve the underlying 3D scene state or translate into executable actions. We introduce RoboPhys-3D, a 3D-grounded EWM benchmark built on RoboTwin 2.0, covering 50 manipulation tasks across four regimes, with 5,000 episodes and 25,000 multi-view ground-truth videos. A defining feature of RoboPhys-3D is that generated and ground-truth videos are processed through the same 3D reconstruction pipeline, enabling reconstruction-induced error to be distinguished from generation-induced error. The RoboPhys-3D benchmark organizes 50 complementary metrics into 18 sub-dimensions across four levels: pixel-level fidelity, 3D geometry consistency, state-level understanding, and task-level completeness. translated_title: RoboPhys-3D：基于三维重建的具身世界模型综合评估
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型日益成为具身智能的数据引擎、动作规划器和模拟器，但传统的具身世界模型（EWM）基准缺乏统一的基于三维的评估协议，无法确定生成的推演结果是否保留了底层的三维场景状态，或能否转化为可执行的动作。我们提出了RoboPhys-3D，这是一个基于RoboTwin 2.0构建的以三维为基础的具身世界模型基准，涵盖四种模式下的50个操作任务，包含5,000个回合和25,000个多视角真值视频。RoboPhys-3D的一个显著特点是，生成的视频和真值视频通过相同的三维重建流程进行处理，从而能够将重建引起的误差与生成引起的误差区分开来。RoboPhys-3D基准将50个互补的指标组织成18个子维度，涵盖四个层次：像素级保真度、三维几何一致性、状态级理解和任务级完整性。我们进一步
tldr: 提出了基于三维重建的具身世界模型评估基准RoboPhys-3D，通过让生成视频与真值视频经过同一三维重建流程来区分生成误差与重建误差，并从像素保真度、三维几何一致性、状态理解和任务完整性四个层面共50项指标全面评估视频世界模型。
en_tdlr: RoboPhys-3D is a 3D-grounded embodied world model benchmark that processes generated and ground-truth videos through the same 3D reconstruction pipeline to disentangle generation-induced from reconstruction-induced errors, comprehensively evaluating video world models with 50 metrics across pixel-level fidelity, 3D geometry consistency, state-level understanding, and task-level completeness.
